description_en: Registers a media stream file stored in OSS with the media service and attaches the media stream to a specified MediaId
description_zh: 该接口用于将OSS上媒体流文件注册到媒体服务，并将该媒体流挂在到指定的MediaId下
kebab_example: aliyun ice register-media-stream --input-url oss://000/API-test/900d1-b8rs8.aac --media-id 5e778ec0027b71ed80a8909598506000 --user-data MessageCallback_:_CallbackURL_:_http://test.test.com_,_Extend_:_localId_:_xxx_,_test_:_www --stream-tags key1_:_value1 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RegisterMediaStream

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the media asset in another service. The URL is associated with the ID of the media asset in IMS. The URL cannot be modified once registered.

Set this parameter to the OSS URL of the media asset. The following formats are supported:

http(s)://example-bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/example.mp4

oss\://example-bucket/example.mp4: In this format, it is considered by default that the region of the OSS bucket in which the media asset resides is the same as the region in which IMS is activated
parameters.help_zh:
待注册的媒资在相应系统中的地址，一经注册不可更改，并与IMS的mediaId绑定。

OSS地址，支持两种格式。

标准 HTTP(S) 格式：http(s)://example-bucket.oss-cn-shanghai.aliyuncs.com/example.mp4

OSS 内部格式：oss://example-bucket/example.mp4，此格式默认oss region与服务接入区域一致
parameters.name: input_url

parameters.help_en: The ID of the media asset
parameters.name: media_id

parameters.help_en:
Custom stream tags used to identify transcoding streams.

After the media stream is registered, you can invoke GetPlayInfo (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ims/developer-reference/api-ice-2020-11-09-getplayinfo?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-193643.d_5_0_3_1_4.56dc5a11JzNEVj) to retrieve this tag value
parameters.help_zh:
自定义流标签，用于标识转码流。

媒体流注册完成后，调用GetPlayInfo (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/ims/developer-reference/api-ice-2020-11-09-getplayinfo?spm=a2c4g.11186623.help-menu-193643.d_5_0_3_1_4.56dc5a11JzNEVj)可获取此标签值
parameters.name: stream_tags

MediaId.description_en: The ID of the media asset
